Home.title: Sparrow Zoo
Home.subtitle: Modern Admin Dashboard
Home.description: Turnkey i18n, theme switching and a component system — build with elegant code.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.desc: Multi-language via next-intl, URL-prefix routing, works out of the box.

theme.title: Theme Switching
theme.desc: Dark / light / system, one-click toggle with smooth transitions.

components.title: Component System
components.desc: shadcn/ui + Tailwind, a unified design language to build pages fast.

FormsExample.title: Form Components Example
FormsExample.desc: Demonstrates the six components in src/common/components/forms: validated inputs and table search components.
FormsExample.search-demo-desc: SearchInput and SearchSelect write into a search-condition state.
FormsExample.form-demo-desc: ValidatableInput / ValidatableSelect / ValidatableDate / ValidatableTextarea, wired to react-hook-form.

UploadExample.title: File Upload Example
UploadExample.desc: Demonstrates the FileUploader component. The upload URL is configured via the NEXT_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_URL environment variable.
UploadExample.upload-hint: Click to select a file to upload

AccessHistoriesExample.title: Access Histories Example
AccessHistoriesExample.desc: Demonstrates the AccessHistories component: a breadcrumb bar that tracks recently visited pages, with auto-update, per-item removal and clear-all.
AccessHistoriesExample.demo-desc: Click the buttons below to simulate visits — the history bar updates in real time. Click a chip to navigate, the × to remove one entry, and the trash icon to clear all.

HooksExample.title: Custom Hooks Example
HooksExample.desc: Demonstrates the four hooks in src/common/hook: reach-bottom loading, cross-origin storage, captcha and safe redirect.
HooksExample.reach-bottom-desc: Scroll to the bottom to auto-load the next page (simulated pagination).
HooksExample.storage-desc: Unified read/write across origins; falls back to localStorage/sessionStorage when STORAGE_PROXY is unset.
HooksExample.captcha-desc: Click the image to refresh; NEXT_PUBLIC_CAPTCHA_URL is required to load the image.
HooksExample.navigating-desc: Builds redirect URLs with the correct locale prefix from useLocale.
HooksExample.navigating-confirm: You are about to leave this page. Continue?

LoadingExample.title: Loading Components Example
LoadingExample.desc: Demonstrates two loading indicators: ThreeDotLoading (bouncing dots) and LoadingSpinner (pulsing dots).
LoadingExample.showcase-desc: Both components take no props and render out of the box.
LoadingExample.usage-desc: Show while loading, hide when done. Click the button to simulate a 1.5s request.

ErrorExample.title: Error Message Example
ErrorExample.desc: Demonstrates two error scenarios: form validation (ErrorMessage) and the full-screen error page (ErrorShower).
ErrorExample.shower-desc: A wavy-animated ERROR display; pass the error text.
ErrorExample.message-desc: Shows red text on error, a green check when valid and submitted.

DraggableExample.title: Draggable Example
DraggableExample.desc: Demonstrates the Draggable component: wrap a single child element and drag it freely with @dnd-kit.
DraggableExample.sandbox-desc: Three independent draggable cards. Each Draggable owns its own DndContext, so they don't interfere.
DraggableExample.usage-desc: Wrap any single element — a div, a button — in Draggable to make it movable.
DraggableExample.drag-hint: Grab and drag the button to move it around.

TableExample.title: Table Components Example
TableExample.desc: Demonstrates the full table system in src/common/components/table: DataTable, headers, cells, pagination and empty state.
TableExample.main-desc: Search, batch operations, row selection, sorting, filtering, column visibility, editable cells and pagination — all in one table.
TableExample.tree-desc: Hierarchical rows with expand/collapse using TreeCell.
TableExample.pagination-desc: Standalone Pagination / PaginationContent / PaginationItem / PaginationLink building blocks.
TableExample.empty-desc: EmptyRow shows a placeholder when there are no rows.
TableExample.name: Name

LinkConfig.title: Compile Error Root Cause
LinkConfig.desc: Explains why react-next-admin and common compile differently: same source, different ESLint config.

I18nStaticExport.title: Static Export & Middleware
I18nStaticExport.desc: Explains the relationship between static export (output: 'export') and src/middleware.ts, and the static replacements.

ZipDownloadExample.title: ZIP Download Pitfall Log
ZipDownloadExample.desc: A summary of the backend zip-download pitfalls and fixes: file filtering, CORS response headers, non-ASCII filename encoding, and the Fetcher.download implementation.
